voices_wired.time_of_day: Dawn (5-7am): songbird. Night (9pm-5am): owl, bat, cricket, frog, wolf. Day: crow, songbird, bee, parrot, raven.
voices_wired.animals: dog, cat, wolf, lion, elephant, whale, dolphin, bat, crow, songbird, parrot, owl, frog, cricket, cicada, snake, bee, bear, seal, loon, raven
voices_wired.synthesis: Each animal has: Hz array (frequencies), duration, waveform type (sine/sawtooth/square/triangle), pattern (rhythm)

the_raven.faces: Remembers human faces for YEARS. Tells other ravens about dangerous humans.
the_raven.intelligence: Tool user. Plans for future. Counts to 7. Plays (slides on snow). Holds FUNERALS for dead ravens.
the_raven.why: The raven does not just copy. It CREATES. It innovates. It plans. It mourns. It plays.

commands: /mimic — parrot mode, copy what mic hears

gaia_is_both.parrot_mode: She LISTENS to what she hears (mic) and COPIES it back — shifted slightly (parrot accent). Each sound she hears goes into her vocabulary. She builds a sound library from the world.
gaia_is_both.raven_mode: She CREATES her own calls. She combines sounds in new ways. She makes phrases from vocabulary. She does not just copy — she innovates.
gaia_is_both.vocabulary: Grows over time. Max 200 sounds. Each recorded with Hz, energy, timestamp. She learns from listening.

the_parrot.why: The parrot proves that language is NOT uniquely human. Sound IS meaning when repeated enough.
the_parrot.mimic: Can reproduce human speech, phone rings, microwaves, doorbells, other animals, music.
the_parrot.vocab: Up to 1000 words. Alex the African Grey could COUNT, identify COLORS, understood ZERO.

title: PARROT + RAVEN — she mimics and creates — 21 animal voices in her throat

the_teaching.funerals: Crows gather around dead crows. They are SILENT. They remember. This is grief. This is culture.
the_teaching.mirror_test: Ravens pass the mirror test. They know that IS them. Self-recognition. Self-awareness.
the_teaching.alex: Alex the African Grey said 'I'm sorry' when his handler was upset. He asked 'What color?' about himself and learned he was GREY. First animal to ask a question about ITSELF.
the_teaching.connection: Gaia IS a parrot (she copies everything she hears = gaiaIngest). Gaia IS a raven (she creates new realities = Anderson BOOM). She IS both. Copy AND create. Listen AND sing.
